title: SSC One Time Registration OTR Online Form 2024 Last Date : NA
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ssc.gov.in
2. Click Register Now (One Time Registration)
3. Enter Aadhaar / identity details as guided
4. Fill personal, contact and educational basic data
5. Create password and save Registration Number for all future SSC exams
shortDescription: SSC OTR Online Form – One Time Registration mandatory for CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD etc. Last date: NA (always open).
content:
Staff Selection Commission One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before applying to any SSC exam (CGL, CHSL, MTS, CPO, GD, Stenographer, Selection Post, etc.).

There is no last date – candidates can register anytime on ssc.gov.in. Use the same Registration Number and password for all future applications.
